paper.title: Performance of the MACE-MP-0 potential for calculating viscosity in LiF molten salt.

result.summary: 本文用分子动力学模拟研究了熔融 LiF 的粘度，比较了 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势与经典 Buckingham 和 Born-Huggins-Mayer 势的表现 [abstract]。结果显示 MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在整个液态范围内较准确地重现实验粘度，而经典势预测的粘度偏低 [abstract]。作者还发现，仅通过加热晶体结构得到的 MACE-MP-0 熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [abstract]。作者认为 MACE 势的动力学行为对准确模拟该体系不可或缺，并指出专用势有望指导实验和工业应用 [S4.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在熔融 LiF 的分子动力学模拟中，机器学习势 MACE-MP-0 能否比经典势更准确地计算粘度 [S1.p4]。研究动机来自熔盐在太阳能电池、电解质、核反应堆冷却剂和燃料载体等方面的应用 [S1.p1]，而粘度是决定热工水力工作流体性能的关键性质 [S1.p3]。此前用经典分子动力学研究 LiF 粘度时，Buckingham 势在明显偏移的温度下预测粘度，BHM 势稍好但仍不理想 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.

Molten salts such as LiF have received long term and recent interest due to their use in solar cells, as electrolytes and solvents, and potential utilisation as coolant fluids in nuclear reactors, along with metals.
Viscosity is one key property governing the performance of working fluids in thermal hydraulics
the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature
Ciccotti et al. reported a slightly better agreement using the Born-Huggins-Mayer (BHM) potential

method.text: 论文采用分子动力学模拟熔融 LiF，使用的势包括 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势以及经典 Buckingham 和 Born-Huggins-Mayer 势 [abstract]。作者通过加热晶体结构来估算熔点 [abstract]，并将计算得到的粘度与实验粘度数据进行比较 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: We perform molecular dynamics simulations of molten Lithium Fluoride using the MACE-MP-0 (small) machine learnt interatomic potential and the classical Buckingham and Born-Huggins-Mayer potentials.
We find that the melting temperature simulated by MACE-MP-0, simply by heating a crystal structure, is significantly closer to the experimental melting temperature of LiF.
Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.

experiments.text: 验证设置是熔融 LiF 的分子动力学模拟，比较对象为 MACE-MP-0（small）与经典 Buckingham 和 Born-Huggins-Mayer 势 [abstract]。评估指标包括跨液态范围的粘度与实验数据的吻合程度，以及通过加热晶体结构得到的熔点与实验熔点的接近程度 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: We perform molecular dynamics simulations of molten Lithium Fluoride using the MACE-MP-0 (small) machine learnt interatomic potential and the classical Buckingham and Born-Huggins-Mayer potentials.
We find that the MACE-MP-0, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental viscosity across the liquid state.
We find that the melting temperature simulated by MACE-MP-0, simply by heating a crystal structure, is significantly closer to the experimental melting temperature of LiF.

findings.text: MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在整个液态范围内较准确地重现实验粘度 [abstract]。经典势预测的粘度偏低，此前被归因于熔点被抑制 [abstract]。仅通过加热晶体结构，MACE-MP-0 模拟的熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [abstract]。作者认为 MACE 势的动力学行为与经典势有定性差异，对准确模拟该体系不可或缺 [S4.p4]。

evidence.quote: We find that the MACE-MP-0, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental viscosity across the liquid state.
Whilst the previous predicted viscosities from classical potentials are under-predicted, which has previously been attributed to a suppressed melting temperature.
We find that the melting temperature simulated by MACE-MP-0, simply by heating a crystal structure, is significantly closer to the experimental melting temperature of LiF.

The far superior prediction of the viscosity and melting temperature of LiF indicate that the dynamics resulting the MACE potential, which differ qualitatively from those of classical potentials, are indispensable to the accurate simulation of this system.

limitations.text: 作者指出，分子模拟中熔点的确定受多种因素影响，例如周期性边界条件导致没有实验中的自由表面或界面来促进熔化，以及 MD 系统尺寸较小导致缺少长波长和低频声子 [S3.p3]。因此，从晶体结构逐渐加热可能并不普遍准确地确定熔点，其他方法如计算固液相自由能、模拟相共存等可以替代 [S3.p3]。作者明确表示，本工作的目标和重点是计算与预测粘度等输运性质，而非准确确定熔点，后者留待未来研究 [S3.p3]。此外，MACE 势相比经典两体势增加了计算负担 [S4.p1]。

evidence.quote: simulated systems often employ periodic boundary conditions and hence have no free surfaces or interfaces, present experimentally, which promote melting.
Another factor is the small system sizes in MD simulations compared to experiments.
gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point

the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations.
The MACE potential is able to more accurately reproduce experimental properties of molten LiF, but at the cost of an increased computational load versus classical two-body potentials.
